trades.label: Excavation and site layout
trades.summary: Pre-cut, laser-marked hub stakes, batter boards, grade stakes and spoil-setback lath, each with a QR that resolves to its exact plan coordinate, beside the LandXML and PNEZD files for GPS machine control.
trades.highlight: Stake kit for 26 points with a QR to each plan coordinate, layout 5.9 mm p50 (simulated), 233 m3 planning / 248 m3 TIN cut, 32 truck loads.
trades.code: BC OHS Regulation Part 20 (20.78, 20.79, 20.81, 20.90); BCBC 9.12; BC Land Surveyors Act (BCLS keeps legal survey)

trades.label: Foundations and concrete formwork
trades.summary: Footing form boards with a laser-burned pour line, stakes, spreaders and keyway strips, plus pressure-treated sill plates with anchor-bolt positions burned at 2.4 m centres or less.
trades.highlight: 20 anchor-bolt centres pre-marked on PT sills, footing forms with the pour line burned, 5.7% form-lumber waste.
trades.code: BCBC 9.15 (footings and foundations), 9.23.6 (anchorage), 9.23.7 (sill plates), 9.12; CSA S406 for permanent wood foundations; CSA A23.1 concrete

trades.label: Wall framing
trades.summary: Every plate, stud, jack, king, cripple, header and block of the 10 walls cut to length and nested from real stock, plates laser-marked with stud layout, studs burned with box heights and pre-bored for cable, bundled by wall in assembly order.
trades.highlight: 375 wall members from the real run, house-wide nest waste 2.71% against a 10% order allowance; plates carry the burned stud layout.

trades.label: Floor and roof framing
trades.summary: Floor joists, rim joists, ceiling joists and rafters with birdsmouth and plumb cuts at the 30.3 degree pitch, cut to the exact model length and marked where each one bears.
trades.highlight: 44 rafters with both plumb cuts and a burned birdsmouth line; no saw work on the roof.
trades.code: BCBC 9.23.3 to 9.23.4 joists and rafters (span tables), 9.23.9 floor joists, 9.23.13 roof framing

trades.label: Stairs and guards
trades.summary: Stringers with every rise/run notch burned on, treads, risers, landing, newels and balusters, all sized from the model's floor-to-floor height so every riser is equal.
trades.highlight: 14 equal risers of 192.9 mm, run 255 mm, all notches burned on 6 stringers; 24 balusters at <= 100 mm gap.
trades.code: BCBC 9.8.4 (rise 125 to 200 mm, run 255 to 355 mm private stairs), 9.8.7 handrails, 9.8.8 guards (100 mm max opening)

trades.label: Deck (example add-on, not in the sample model)
trades.summary: A 3.6 x 2.4 m deck off the rear wall: ledger with burned bolt pattern and joist marks, joists, beam, posts and decking cut to length.
trades.highlight: Ledger with 9 bolts and 9 joist positions burned on; 33 PT parts cut to length (example deck).
trades.code: BCBC 9.23 (wood frame), 9.8.8.1 (guards needed above 600 mm), 9.3.2.9 / CSA O80 (treated wood); municipal deck guide

trades.label: Windows and doors
trades.summary: A rough-opening gauge stick pair for every window and door, burned with the RO size and the unit size, so each opening is checked before the windows arrive.
trades.highlight: 14 openings each get a burned RO gauge pair; bad openings are caught before the window order lands.
trades.code: BCBC 9.7 (windows, doors), CSA A440.4 installation, 9.23.12 lintels

trades.label: Roofing and fascia
trades.summary: Sub-fascia with every rafter tail burned on, and rake boards with the 30.3 degree plumb cuts, so the eave line is straight and the drip edge goes on once.
trades.highlight: Sub-fascia with 22 rafter tails burned on, rakes with 30.3 degree plumb cuts; 7.5 squares from the model.

trades.label: Siding, rainscreen and exterior trim
trades.summary: Rainscreen furring, corner boards, belly band and picture-frame window trim cut with 45 degree mitres from the window sizes in the model.
trades.highlight: 13 mitred window and door trim kits plus rainscreen furring for 129 m2 of wall, labelled by opening.
trades.code: BCBC 9.27 (cladding), 9.27.2.2 capillary break / rainscreen (required in most of BC coastal climate)

trades.label: Insulation and air barrier
trades.summary: Eave insulation stops and the attic hatch dam cut to the rafter bays, with the vent-baffle line burned on, plus batt counts from the model's wall and ceiling areas.
trades.highlight: 42 eave stops with the 63 mm vent-baffle line burned on, hatch dam, and a 288-batt takeoff from 129 m2 of net wall.
trades.code: BCBC 9.25 (heat transfer, air leakage, vapour), 9.36 (energy efficiency), 9.19.1 (attic venting)

trades.label: Electrical rough-in
trades.summary: Studs arrive with every box burned at its model height and every cable hole pre-bored at the code-safe position, so the electrician walks the house pulling wire instead of drilling.
trades.highlight: 108 cable holes pre-bored and 31 box heights burned on 121 studs; drilling time drops from about 3.6 h to 1.3 h (est.).
trades.code: BCBC 9.23.5.3 (holes in studs), CEC C22.1 (box heights, cable protection), MEP-008 box marks

trades.label: Plumbing
trades.summary: Wet-wall blocking for every fixture cut and burned with the stub-out centre lines from the model, plus the drain list with joist checks.
trades.highlight: 9 wet-wall blocks for 4 fixtures, each burned with its stub-out centre line; 4 drains checked, 1 flagged for the designer.
trades.code: BC Plumbing Code (BCBC Division B Part 7), BCBC 9.23.5 notching and drilling

trades.label: HVAC and ventilation
trades.summary: Register and grille openings framed from the model's air terminal positions: blocking cut to the joist bay with the opening edges burned on it.
trades.highlight: 7 registers and grilles framed from model coordinates (14 burned headers); no guessing where the diffuser lands.
trades.code: BCBC 9.32 (ventilation), 9.33 (heating), CSA F280 sizing; BCBC 9.23.5 for framing cuts

trades.label: Drywall
trades.summary: Backing and ladder blocking at every corner and partition, plus a sheet-by-sheet board layout per wall from the model so the board order matches the walls.
trades.highlight: 16 ladder blocks so no board edge floats, and a 70-sheet layout by wall.
trades.code: BCBC 9.29.5 (gypsum board), ASTM C840 / GA-216 application

trades.label: Finish carpentry and trim
trades.summary: Baseboard per wall with coped/mitred corners and scarf joints over studs, plus door and window casing kits, cut from room dimensions in the model.
trades.highlight: 71 baseboard and casing pieces with mitres cut and labelled by room and wall.
trades.code: Finish work (no code limits beyond 9.8 guards and handrails)

trades.label: Flooring
trades.summary: Plank rows laid out per room: the cell cuts every starter and end piece, carries each offcut to start the next row, and keeps end joints 300 mm apart.
trades.highlight: Row-by-row plank layout: 45 rows start from an earlier offcut, 0.9% crosscut waste (last-row rip excluded) on 230 planks.
trades.code: Manufacturer installation (expansion gap 12 mm, end-joint stagger >= 300 mm); BCBC 9.30 flooring

trades.label: Cabinets, millwork and backing
trades.summary: Cabinet, vanity and TV backing cut to the stud bays with screw lines burned at the model heights, plus a countertop list for the fabricator.
trades.highlight: Backing for 11 cabinets, vanity, TV and grab bar in before drywall; no opening walls later.
trades.code: Manufacturer installation; backing for grab bars (BCBC 3.8 / 9.31 where applicable)
